[[Spawning Power]] | damagetype = [[Dark damage]] | unique = yes }} [[Plague-Soaked Stave]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[wand]] dropped by [[Imperial Guard Lockbox]]es. ==Stats== :[[Dark damage|Dark Dmg]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Divine Favor]]) :Dark Dmg: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Fast Casting]]) :Dark Dmg: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Soul Reaping]]) :Dark Dmg: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Energy Storage]]) :Dark Dmg: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Spawning Power]]) :[[Energy]] +5 (while [[Health]] is above 50%) :[[HSR|Halves skill recharge]] of [[spell]]s (Chance: 10%) ==Replica== Except for the visual appearance and [[damage type]], it is possible to create a replica of this wand with the same stats. Replicas will cause the damage type associated with the inherent [[attribute]]. Create a replica with the following: *One of the following wands with the appropriate attribute: **[[Asuran Scepter]] from crafter [[Nojj]] **[[Balthazar's Rod]] from collector [[Zaishen Weapon Master]] **[[Deldrimor Scepter]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]] **[[Fan of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]] **[[Norn Scepter]] from crafter [[Keti]] **[[Oppressor's Scepter]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]] **Wand from crafters [[Shausha]], [[Hadusi]], [[Tehshan]], [[Asa]], [[Soros]], or [[Derrick]] **[[Charr Scepter]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]]) **[[Mursaat Scepter]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack) **[[Tengu Scepter]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack) **[[Undead Scepter]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack) *[[Perfect]] [[Wand Wrapping]] [[of Quickening]] *Perfect [["Hale and Hearty"]] inscription ==Unique counterparts== * [[Imperial Dragon Wand]], [[The People's Will]] and [[Xun Rao's Justice]] have stats nearly identical to this item; however, they inflict [[Fire damage]]. * [[Mallyx's Faith]] and [[Peace]] have stats nearly identical to this item; however, they inflict Fire damage and require [[Divine Favor]]. * [[Chidehkir's Deliverance]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts [[Holy damage]] and requires [[Healing Prayers]]. * [[Mallyx's Malice]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it requires [[Soul Reaping]]. * [[Vulnero's Curse]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts [[Cold damage]] and requires [[Curses]]. * [[Terob's Wand]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts Cold damage and requires [[Death Magic]]. * [[Mina's Gaze]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts [[Chaos damage]] and requires [[Domination Magic]]. * [[Mallyx's Whim]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts Chaos damage and requires [[Inspiration Magic]]. * [[Mallyx's Endurance]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts [[Earth damage]] and requires [[Energy Storage]]. * [[Mallyx's Whim]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts [[Lightning damage]] and requires [[Spawning Power]]. ==Notes== *Except for Soul Reaping wands, [[Wand#Damage types of other staves|non-randomly generated]] Divine Favor, Fast Casting, Soul Reaping, Energy Storage, and Spawning Power wands do not usually deal dark damage. ==Trivia== *This weapon was originally going to be a [[sword]] called Guardsbane, referencing the [[Minister Cho's Estate]] opening cinematic.
